g.text: Parse parts, --id, files, voices and TSV
Identify parentless trunks and metadata-bearing file nodes
roots_known distinguishes witness trunks from other roots
rows_under computes claim/voice tallies and optional TSV
down_from and tally_under; print detailed claim and voice counts
Print walk counts and games/tokens; close TSV and database
Free DAG, readers, holds and maps; return 0
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Games and tokens remain separate tallies; a parentless trunk is not automatically
a registered witness. Walker, record classification and tally semantics remain nested and
inspectable in source. Source review only; no Engine command executed.
